content: In a note MK observes that Niʿmatullahi sources claim both Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī sought out Niʿmat Allāh Valī to express devotion; he places this beside, without identifying it with, the second apology's unnamed khirqa-giver.
refers_to_primary: Farzām, Taḥqīq dar Aḥvāl, 254-55 (via MK, fn 40)
